svg.title: Ziganya AI member health score algorithm
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing how the nightly cron job reads five data signals from the database, weights them, combines them into a 0-100 health score, classifies churn risk, and triggers admin alerts or member interventions.

sendPrompt('How is the final Ziganya health score calculated from the five signals?')
sendPrompt('How does Ziganya classify churn risk levels?')
